PHASE 6, SELF-APPROVED 2026-09-08 (robots.txt)
Branch: refresh/p6-seo-launch

SHIPPED
  robots.txt rewritten. 161 lines -> 70. 34 user-agent groups -> 2.

THE BUG THIS CLOSES
32 named crawler groups each contained nothing but "Allow: /". Google's spec:
"Only one applicable group is used for a crawler... User-agent-specific groups and
the global * group are not combined."

So GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot,
Bingbot, CCBot, Google-Extended, Applebot and 22 others each matched their own
group and were EXEMPT from all three Disallow rules. Every one of them could crawl
/dealer/admin.html, /dealer/thanks.html and /services-schema-block.html.

The groups read as permissive and were functionally a hole.

Deleting them changes nothing about what is permitted (Allow:/ was already the
default) and restores the three Disallows for every crawler.

ALSO
  Bravebot removed. Fictional UA. This is the single check that has failed SEO
  Verify for the whole session; it reads the live site, so it turns green on merge.
  Bytespider Disallow:/ preserved, the one deliberate refusal.
  Content-Signal labelled [SPECULATIVE] in-file: not a supported field, no crawler
  is known to honour it, and it must never be described as a control.

VERIFIED LOCALLY against the verifier's own assertions, all 7 pass.
